emails.subject_line_a: Quick build for Horizon Roof Restoration
emails.body_text:
Hey Matthew,

I was looking at horizonrr.com — huge respect for growing Horizon Roof Restoration across Central and South Charlotte.

One mobile conversion leak caught my eye: horizonrr.com has no embedded quote form on the homepage or /roof-estimates/ — mobile homeowners have to click over to Contact without seeing any rough Charlotte ballpark first.

So I built a working 30-second Charlotte Roof Estimator in your navy-and-copper Horizon Roof Restoration branding. Homeowners tap their roof size, slope, and material tier to see an honest local ballpark before leaving their name and phone.

Mind if I send over the live preview link?

— {{sender_name}}

{{sender_address}} | {{unsubscribe_line}}

objection_handlers.objection: Every Charlotte roof has different decking, flashing, and code needs — I don't want online quotes boxing us in.
objection_handlers.reframe_response: 100% agree — this never issues a binding bid. It gives an honest Charlotte & Carolinas ballpark range with a clear on-site inspection disclaimer so low-ball shoppers filter themselves out while qualified homeowners book already expecting real licensed pricing ($12,600–$17,400+).

objection_handlers.objection: We already get strong word-of-mouth referrals and repeat business.
objection_handlers.reframe_response: That local reputation is gold — and even referred neighbors still pull up horizonrr.com on their phone at 8pm before calling. A 30-second estimator simply captures the ready-to-buy homeowners already visiting your site who want a ballpark before dialing.

objection_handlers.objection: Why pay $750 setup + $149/mo when we already have a website contact form?
objection_handlers.reframe_response: Blind static forms leak mobile shoppers who bounce before typing 7+ fields. This drops directly onto your homepage, tags urgent Charlotte storm and leak leads into your priority slot, updates regional pricing quarterly, and a single extra closed roof ($15,500+) pays for 3+ years.

objection_handlers.objection: I don't want anyone breaking or redesigning horizonrr.com.
objection_handlers.reframe_response: Zero redesign required. It's a self-contained 28 KB vanilla JS script wrapped in Shadow DOM isolation so it cannot alter a single CSS rule on horizonrr.com — your web person pastes one line in 5 minutes, and we'll share those site speed fixes free.
